title: Evaluation of the product coefficients
statement: Let $c$ and $d$ be coefficient families indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If the coefficient at $U$ of a new family is the sum of $c(S)d(T)$ over pairs of subsets with $S\cup T=U$, then its algebraic normal form evaluated at $x$ equals the product of the evaluations of $c$ and $d$ at $x$.
